senses.definition: Jos 15:41, בֵּית דָּגֹן 19:27 n.pr.loc.

in Judah (house, i.e. temple of Dagon; Assyrian Bît-Daganna COT Jos 15:41, & i. p. 281) Jos 15:41 (𝔊 Βαγαδιηλ, but 𝔊L Βηθδαγων)—name appears in mod. Beit Dejân, SE. of Jaffa, but loc. unsuitable, cf. RobBR ii. 232.

in Asher Jos 19:27 (𝔊 Βαιθεγενεθ, but 𝔊L Βηθδαγων) perhaps = Beit Dejen, near Akko, cf. Di. JeromeOpp (ed. Vallarsi), iii. 38 defines as domus tritici, and says (Id. ib. 174): ‘sed et usque hodie grandis vicus Capherdago inter Diospolim et Jamniam demonstratur.’ [Elsewhere he defines דגון (Id. ib 48) as ‘piscis tristitiae’] (HPS, privately) as if דָּג יָגוֹן!
